name: cpp-quality-gates
description: Make 'done' mean measured for C++: skills for a sanitizer matrix (ASan, UBSan, TSan, LSan; Linux-in-a-container for macOS), a CRAP gate (lizard + gcovr), mutation testing (universalmutator harness with triage), and a compiler capability matrix, with runnable scripts, CMake presets and CI templates.
